system.description:
Him Who Watches From Below. Associated with eyes, deep places, and truths that destroy the mind that holds them.

  • Dark Gift (1st): For 1 Patron Favour, gain true-sight for 1 minute — see through illusions, polymorph, invisibility, and the true forms of all things.
  • Patron's Mark (4th): For 1 Patron Favour, place an invisible eye anywhere within 60ft — it lasts 10 minutes and relays everything it sees and hears directly to your mind. One active at a time.
  • Patron Feature (8th): For 1 Patron Favour, place an immobile Eye of Bolothamogg within 60ft (AC 15, 30 HP) for 3 rounds. On each of your turns it fires one ray: 6d6 force, Reflex save against your Class Save DC for half; a creature reduced to 0 HP or below by it is disintegrated.

Allegiance: Chaotic Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Bolothamogg in the World of Arneyan wiki.
